sources.title: Kimi K3 License
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The Kimi K3 License grants broad use, copying, modification, distribution, sublicensing, selling, deployment and fine-tuning rights subject to stated conditions.

The license includes a separate-agreement condition for a defined Model-as-a-Service business above USD 20 million aggregate revenue over any consecutive 12 months and an attribution/display condition for covered large commercial products/services, with specified exclusions.

limitations.text: This Evidence card summarizes the named 2026 Kimi K3 License only; it is not a legal opinion and does not establish infringement or compliance by third parties.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify the exact Kimi K3 license grant, Model-as-a-Service condition, revenue/MAU attribution thresholds, exclusions, and subject/version applicability from the license text.
targets.finding: The exact license text establishes the broad grant, the stated Model-as-a-Service revenue condition, the 100M-MAU/USD-20M-monthly-revenue display condition, exclusions, and applicability to the covered Kimi K3 software/weights.
